title: session.waiting
description: A session.bind can't be answered yet: why gen1-bridge is still waiting to put the hidden game on the world's slot. re: the bind's seq.

reason.description: busy: the engine's save gate is closed (a menu, script or battle); new_game: an unsaved New Game waits for the title; save_failed: saving the running game into its own slot failed and is retried.
